response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu != 0 THEN CAST(sp.procgpu AS NUMERIC) / CAST(sp.proccpu AS NUMERIC) ELSE NULL END) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) as avg_of_site_rams, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_ratios FROM site_stats GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat
